# vessel-mind eval results

## 1. Retrieval ablation

`task eval -- --retrieval-only`, 2026-10-26. No LLM calls. Golden set `eval/golden.yaml` (SHA-256 `80d4880e9064`); corpus vessel-mind `09a0890`, vibeconform `384d89e`, 1178 chunks.

Embedding model `jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-zh`; reranker `BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3-int8` (fastembed cross-encoder on CPU) over the top 30 hybrid candidates. Every row returns the top 5.

recall@5: the share of a question's expected documents that a top-5 result comes from. MRR@5: 1 / the rank of the first top-5 result from an expected document (0 if none). Both are averaged over the questions with expected sources. Latency is one search's wall time on this machine's CPU (query embedding, candidate search and, in the rerank row, the cross-encoder), over every question, the unanswerable ones too; each row searches once before timing, so model loading is not counted.

## 2. End to end

Each row asks every golden question once, as a new turn through the router, the way the server answers it. Golden set `eval/golden.yaml` (SHA-256 `80d4880e9064`). The `slow-only` row is `hosted` with the router off, and a `NAME-slow-only` row is configuration NAME with the router off: every turn takes the slow path.

| Row | Fast / slow model | Questions | recall@5 | MRR@5 | Answer score | Citation correctness | Turn p50 s | Turn p95 s | Tokens in / out | List-price cost (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| hosted | gemini-3.5-flash-lite / gemini-3.6-flash | *not run* | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — |
| slow-only | router off / gemini-3.6-flash | *not run* | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — |
| local | qwen3:8b / qwen3.6:35b-a3b | 35 of 35 | 0.81 | 0.85 | 0.84 (1 not judged) | 0.64 (51 of 80) | 22.0 | 57.4 | 226,287 / 38,570 | $0 (GPU electricity not measured) |
| routed | qwen3:8b / gemini-3.6-flash | *not run* | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — |
| local-slow-only | router off / qwen3.6:35b-a3b | 35 of 35 | 0.84 | 0.90 | 0.81 | 0.77 (46 of 60) | 16.4 | 31.9 | 178,836 / 41,980 | $0 (GPU electricity not measured) |

- **hosted** was not run: Its slow model gemini-3.6-flash allows 20 free-tier requests a day, and a row needs about 100 (answers and tool steps); the author chose to run the eval on free models within three days.
- **slow-only** was not run: Its slow model gemini-3.6-flash allows 20 free-tier requests a day, and a row needs about 100 (answers and tool steps); the author chose to run the eval on free models within three days.
- **routed** was not run: Its slow model gemini-3.6-flash allows 20 free-tier requests a day; the author chose to run the eval on free models within three days.

Questions: answered of the golden set; a failed question is counted, never dropped. recall@5: the share of an answerable question's expected documents that the top 5 of any search in the turn come from; MRR@5: 1 / the rank of the first result from an expected document in the turn's first search (both 0 when the turn did not search). Answer score: the share of key points the judge marks covered, averaged over the judged answers (rubric `eval/judge.md`). Citation correctness: the share of the sources the answers cite ([n] mapped to the latest search before it, as the console maps it) whose document is an expected source, checked by code; a citation in an answer to an unanswerable question is never correct. Turn latency: the wall time of the turn on this machine, provider retries included, less the time the eval waited to space its requests. Tokens: classification plus answer, thinking tokens counted as output. List-price cost: tokens × the provider's paid list price on the date shown; the run used the free tier, so nobody paid it. The judge's own tokens are not counted.

### Router: local

Router accuracy against `expected_route`: 0.51 (18 of 35 turns). A fallback counts as the slow route it took.

Costly misroutes: 1 (en-17). A costly misroute is a fast-path answer scoring at least 0.25 below the slow-only answer to the same question.

The judge `qwen3.6:35b-a3b` shares a model family (`qwen`) with the measured rows local, local-slow-only, so its scores may favour them. It is itself a model of local, local-slow-only.
